name: Tesoro
composition: Sea and dense chained ship carpet in foreground; stone stairs and rope ladder at far west end into two-storey gateway tavern; only rear tavern exit leads to elevated platforms and rope bridges across town; under-platform rooms; opposite northeast end abuts high cliff; snowy summit with difficult trail wrapping behind peak, small lighthouse peeking from its far side. Building count free.
provenance: Audio-ASR reference plus narrator-confirmed user supplement, 2026-10-19; supplement supersedes former middle-entrance and ten-to-eleven-house assumptions.
